today.title: Today
today.intro: Three intentions in the morning, a review in the evening. Episodes get written whenever you have a minute — they don't need to be filled mid-situation.

alert.label: The only test that matters
alert.question: When the discomfort came — did I make a workable Toward Move, even though it was hard?

morning.heading: Morning set-up
morning.subtitle: Three buttons you press before the day presses you.
morning.saveError: Your morning set-up couldn't be saved. Please try again.
morning.openLabel: What discomfort am I willing to let in today?
morning.openHint: Feel it without fighting it; think it without obeying it.
morning.openPlaceholder: Tight chest before the review call — allowed to be there.
morning.awareLabel: Where will autopilot most likely take over?
morning.awareHint: Name the situation in advance and you're half-way to catching it.
morning.awarePlaceholder: Right after the standup, when I want to over-explain.
morning.engagedLabel: Who do I want to act like today?
morning.engagedHint: A quality of action, not an outcome. Values are directions, goals are destinations.
morning.engagedPlaceholder: Direct and warm, even when I'd rather be vague.
morning.towardPlaceholder: Give Ann the honest feedback before lunch
morning.footer: Nothing here is scored. It is a direction, not a target.

evening.heading: Evening review

evening.hookLabel: Where did it catch me today?
evening.hookPlaceholder: The comment in the thread about the deadline.
evening.awayLabel: What Away Move did I make?

episodes.title: Episodes
episodes.intro: The raw material. Write them whenever — evening, next morning, three days later. Rough beats absent.
episodes.emptyDescription: Widen the direction or clear the search.

episodeModal.title: New episode
episodeModal.subtitle: Written after the fact. Under a minute.
episodeModal.directionLabel: Which way did the behaviour go?
episodeModal.unpickedNote: Neither is the moral option. Pick the one the behaviour actually went.
episodeModal.towardNote: Toward logged. Note the discomfort didn't have to drop first — that's the whole test.
episodeModal.awayNote: Away logged without a verdict. The useful question is “toward what was it working?”, not “was that bad?”
episodeModal.scaleLabel: A tipping scale showing Away and Toward around the choice point
episodeModal.statusLabel: Status effect — where you got stuck
episodeModal.valueLabel: Value in play — who you wanted to be
episodeModal.towardMovePlaceholder: Asked one clarifying question instead of leaving
episodeModal.workablePlaceholder: Naming the story out loud dropped its grip
episodeModal.flexibilityHint: 0–2 each. 10/10 is not the goal — the pattern over weeks is.
